_comment: The exact page a widget-adding builder tool produces. Read from two sides on purpose: tests/Unit/Support/ManifestWidgetShapeTest.php asserts that OCA\Buildiq\Support\ManifestWidgetShape builds this, and tests/vitest/copilotWidgetShape.spec.js runs the canonical validateManifest() over a manifest carrying it. Change the PHP shape and the first test fails; change this file to match and the second one says whether the new shape is still valid. Before this fixture existed the two tools wrote {type, config}, which no test compared with the validator at all.
